capabilities: Toggle full width for the current note via a header button, command, or context menu
Apply full width automatically from a frontmatter property
Configure path rules and folder rules for always full-width notes
Update configured path rules automatically when notes are renamed
intentEvidence: disable Readable Line Length (enabling Full Width) on specific notes or folders while keeping global Readable Line Length enabled
motivation: The author found the global readable line length setting restricts layouts for large tables, kanban boards, dashboards, and wide diagrams, and wanted control without toggling global settings.
problem: Obsidian's global Readable Line Length setting constrains wide content like tables, dashboards, and boards, with no per-page override.
summary: Per-page width control that disables Readable Line Length (full width) on chosen notes or folders via frontmatter, rules, or a toggle.
